categories.main_business_segments: The company is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the research and development, manufacturing, and sales of customized automotive system connectors. The main business segments include: (1) Abnormal-shaped fasteners (异型紧固件) - accounting for 49.10% of revenue; (2) Standard fasteners (标准紧固件) - accounting for 11.64% of revenue; (3) Seat locks (座椅锁) - accounting for 34.52% of revenue; and (4) Other locks - accounting for 3.03% of revenue. These products are widely applied in automotive body chassis, power systems, safety systems, intelligent electronic systems, and interior/exterior decoration systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include: (1) Cold heading (冷镦) technology for precision forming of complex fasteners with 0.01mm precision; (2) Composite processing techniques combining cold heading with machining, cold extrusion, and stamping; (3) Advanced surface treatment methods including electroplating, phosphating, and Dacromet coating; (4) Precision machining and design capabilities for customized components; (5) Complete product development from software modeling, mechanical simulation, material selection, to process design and sample verification for lock products. The company holds multiple certifications including CNAS national laboratory accreditation, ISO14001, IATF16949, ISO45001, ISO50001, IPMS, and TISAX.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major automotive OEMs including Volkswagen China, GAC Aion, Changan Mazda, Great Wall Motors, and Changan Ford as Tier-1 suppliers. It also supplies to leading global Tier-1 automotive component suppliers including Magna, Faurecia, Lear, Adient, Yanfeng, Boze, Grammer, and Nob. Products are applied in vehicles from brands including BYD, Xiaomi, Hongmeng Smart Travel, Ford, Mazda, GAC Honda, Dongfeng Honda, Geely, Changan, Chery, XPeng, and others. The company has high penetration in mainstream SUV models.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in China, with headquarters and main manufacturing facilities in Wenzhou, Zhejiang Province. It has subsidiaries including Zhejiang Huayue Automotive Components Co., Ltd., Zhejiang Huaou Automotive Components Co., Ltd., and Guangdong Huayue Automotive Components Co., Ltd. In 2024, the company established a wholly-owned subsidiary in Singapore (HUAYARE TECHNOLOGY (SINGAPORE) PTE. LTD.) to support international expansion. Domestic sales account for 93.93% of revenue while export sales account for 4.36%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as both a Tier-1 and Tier-2 supplier in the automotive supply chain. As a Tier-1 supplier, it directly supplies fasteners and locks to major automotive OEMs. As a Tier-2 supplier, it provides products to leading global Tier-1 automotive component suppliers. The company is positioned in the midstream of the supply chain, transforming raw materials (primarily wire materials) into finished automotive components through manufacturing and assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: (1) Deepening precision connection components and driving system full-scenario layout through new materials, new technologies, and new products including aluminum alloy precision connectors, electric lock products, and screw/seat horizontal drive systems; (2) Implementing lean operations management based on full-process cost optimization from design, process, quality, manufacturing to inventory management; (3) Accelerating international strategy deployment through market expansion, production facilities, sales networks, service teams, and R&D collaboration in overseas markets; (4) Continuous technology innovation in cold heading molds, precision machining, and electric lock products. R&D investment in 2024 was 27.54 million yuan (4.04% of revenue).
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured automotive components. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods, which occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance. For domestic sales, revenue is recognized upon product shipment and receipt of customer signature documents. For export sales, revenue is recognized based on Incoterms (FOB, CIF, EXW, FCA) with recognition at bill of lading for FOB/CIF/FCA and at factory delivery for EXW. The company uses cost-plus pricing methodology based on processing difficulty, manufacturing costs, and market conditions. Customers typically negotiate annual price reductions after new product launch.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier of automotive abnormal-shaped fasteners and seat locks. It competes with other fastener manufacturers and automotive component suppliers. The company differentiates itself through: (1) Extensive customer relationships with major global OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers; (2) Advanced cold heading and precision machining technologies enabling 0.01mm precision; (3) Comprehensive product portfolio with over 4,000 fastener types and 10+ lock series with 100+ variants; (4) Strong customization and design capabilities; (5) High penetration in mainstream SUV models (5 of top 10 SUV models use company's seat locks). The company benefits from industry consolidation trends favoring larger, more capable suppliers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized automotive component manufacturer with strong growth trajectory. In 2024, revenue reached 681.7 million yuan (up 23.2% YoY), net profit attributable to shareholders was 107.3 million yuan (up 29.9% YoY), and total assets reached 1.27 billion yuan (up 10.9% YoY). The company achieved 13.34% weighted average ROE and 0.30 yuan basic EPS. Over the past three years (2022-2024), revenue grew from 491.2 million to 681.7 million yuan (38.8% cumulative growth), while net profit grew from 76.8 million to 107.3 million yuan (39.7% cumulative growth). The company maintains healthy profitability with 30.75% gross margin in automotive business.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's key value propositions include: (1) Precision and customization - ability to design and manufacture complex, high-precision fasteners and locks tailored to specific customer requirements with 0.01mm precision; (2) Technology leadership - proprietary cold heading and composite processing technologies enabling cost-effective production of complex components; (3) Comprehensive solutions - extensive product portfolio (4,000+ fastener types, 10+ lock series) enabling one-stop sourcing; (4) Quality and reliability - IATF16949 and multiple international certifications ensuring automotive-grade quality; (5) New energy vehicle readiness - proven capability supplying to leading EV manufacturers with products meeting new energy vehicle requirements; (6) Supply chain integration - established relationships with global Tier-1 suppliers and OEMs providing stable, long-term partnerships; (7) Cost competitiveness - advanced manufacturing processes and supply chain optimization enabling competitive pricing while maintaining margins.
